chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanty, from Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Jabir al-Ja'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

The pilgrims are of three types. The one with the greatest share is a man whose past and future sins are forgiven, and God protects him from the punishment of the Fire. As for the one next to him, it is a man whose past sins are forgiven, and he resumes his deeds for the remainder of his life. As for the one next to him, it is a man whose family and wealth are protected.
ai.seo_question: What are the three categories of Hajj pilgrims and their respective rewards according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq presents this hadith as a gradation of spiritual reward, highlighting that the highest tier involves complete absolution of both past and future sins, a concept deeply resonant with Shia eschatology regarding the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt. The second tier reflects the state of the repentant believer who continues their spiritual journey, while the third emphasizes the worldly stability and protection of one's household as a divine blessing. This classification underscores the holistic nature of faith, linking ritual performance with both eternal salvation and temporal well-being.
